title: DATESINPERIOD going forward 3 days starts on the start date
query: EVALUATE DATESINPERIOD ( 'Date'[Date], DATE ( 2024, 2, 28 ), 3, DAY ) ORDER BY 'Date'[Date]

source.quote: The second query returns 3 days, starting from August 15, 2008
source.supports: the example with 3, DAY returns the start date and the two days after it

derivation: Three days starting 2024-02-28: February 28, the leap day February 29, and March 1.
